title: [review] messaging.py:144: `self._next_id` is never updat
description: In `render_post`, the code reads `self._next_id` into `candidate_next_id` and computes a new value (line 142 or 144), but never writes it back to `self._next_id`. Every POST without an explicit ID will get ID 1, causing message collisions in `_sent`. Fix: add `self._next_id = candidate_next_id` before line 145.
close_reason: Fixed: Added self._next_id = candidate_next_id at line 145 to persist the auto-incremented ID counter. Without this, every POST without an explicit ID would get ID 1, causing collisions in _sent.
